description: Machine-readable intent of the five pinned spec fixtures. These fixtures ARE the monthly-absorption test. Catalog-diff tests should read expectations from here rather than hard-coding endpoint names, so that changing a fixture forces changing its declared expectation in the same commit.

derived_from.historical_baseline: a legacy MCP tool-list catalog (66 tools, generated 2026-05-04), used only to ground the price-changed and endpoint-removed deltas in measured reality

severity_classes.ADDED: warn, but UNMAPPED owner gate BLOCKs in CI

reprice_threshold.rule: factor = max(new/old, old/new); factor >= 2 is REPRICED_MAJOR, factor < 2 is REPRICED_MINOR

current.intent: A faithful trimmed snapshot of the pinned spec. Every paths: block is a byte-identical slice; tests/fixtures/spec.test.mjs enforces that.
covers: flat pricing (clean_domain 0.5, email_finder 5, email_verifier 2, enrich_profile 1, find_personal_email 5, phone_finder 25, predict_gender 1, web_emails 2)
per_result with _list_count, a field appearing in zero spec examples (enrich_profiles_bulk, enrich_companies_bulk)
per_result with a field the response really carries (people_search numberOfElements, linkedin_ad_search elements, post_keyword_search numberOfElements)
base_plus_per_result with a NON-ZERO base (lead_search: 10 base + 0.5/result) — a call that costs 10 credits even when it returns nothing
bulk/single pair for auto-batching (enrich_profile <-> enrich_profiles_bulk, max 50)
the two endpoints in the whole spec with NO response example at all (enrich_profiles_bulk, enrich_companies_bulk)
the endpoint whose entire example is the literal string "example" (email_finder)
endpoints declaring zero required request fields (email_finder, phone_finder) — a known hazard, not a green light
deliberately unclaimed endpoints for the owner gate (predict_gender: bias risk; post_keyword_search: enabled, but no skill searches posts by keyword)
current.breaking_this_means: Every other spec fixture is a delta on this file. Regenerating it without re-deriving the deltas silently invalidates every drift assertion in the repo.

expected_findings.note: One of the 15 endpoints that really appeared between 2026-05 and 2026-08. Block is a byte-identical slice of the pinned spec.

expected_findings.gate: owner gate — _lib/endpoint-owners.yaml lists it under neither endpoints: nor unclaimed:, so CI must fail

endpoint-added.breaking_this_means: A new paid endpoint lands in the catalog with no owner and no reviewed cost — the path by which a skill starts quoting a price nobody checked.

expected_findings.note: True removal. Nothing in the candidate resembles it. Real analogues: find_emails, verify_emails, check_email_finding, check_email_verification, check_usage, person_enricher, company_enricher — 7 endpoints really deleted with no successor.

Operation body is byte-identical except operationId and the path key: same request schema, same response example, same x-pricing. Fuzzy match must classify this as RENAMED, NOT as REMOVED_UNMAPPED + ADDED. This is the real ad_search -> linkedin_ad_search pair replayed in reverse so that current.yaml can remain a faithful snapshot of the pinned spec; fuzzy matching is order-independent.

endpoint-removed.breaking_this_means: If the true removal stops blocking, a skill keeps routing to an endpoint that 404s mid-run. If the rename stops being detected, the monthly diff shows 13 blocking removals, a human switches the gate off in month two, and the gate is worth nothing.

price-changed.diff_direction: price-changed.yaml -> current.yaml (INVERTED relative to the other fixtures, on purpose)
price-changed.why_inverted: This file is the 2026-05 pricing state of the same 15 endpoints. Diffing it forward into current.yaml replays the repricing that really happened instead of inventing numbers, while letting current.yaml stay a faithful snapshot of the pinned spec. Treating it as the candidate turns every increase into a decrease.

expected_findings.note: The measured headline case from law 1. A 500-row phone pass moves from 1,500 to 12,500 credits.
A 2 -> 5 reprice can look minor, but it is 2.5x and the threshold puts REPRICED_MAJOR at >=2x, so it BLOCKs. web_emails is the genuinely-minor case.
Exactly the >= boundary. An implementation using > instead of >= passes every other case in this file and fails only this one.
The genuinely-minor, warn-only case. Real: web_emails really went 3 -> 2 in this window.

flat 6/call -> 0.1/result on the page count. A naive numeric comparison reads 6 -> 0.1 as a price cut and warns only; the formula change must subsume it and BLOCK, because every cost estimate for this endpoint used the old formula.

must_not_produce: any finding for the 10 endpoints whose pricing is unchanged
price-changed.breaking_this_means: A bot-committed price increase reaches users unreviewed — the first failure mode the monthly-absorption test exists to catch.

malformed.breaking_this_means: One bad download empties the catalog; because the catalog is the source of truth for cost and routing (law 1), every skill loses its prices at once.
